newsitem.title: USA: SunGard Recovery, DEC in marketing deal.
newsitem.headline: SunGard Recovery, DEC in marketing deal.

text.p: SunGard Recovery Services Inc, the disaster recovery unit of SunGard Data Systems Inc, said on Monday it had formed a strategic marketing and sales agreement with Digital Equipment Corp.
Under the agreement, the two companies will jointly market SunGard's disaster recovery services to Digital's customers throughout North America, the company said.
The companies first formed a relationship in April 1996, when SunGard acquired the assets of Digital's North American recovery services business.
SunGard acquired subscriber agreements for Digital's recovery customers, as well as hardware assets formerly used at Digital's recovery centers in the United States and Canada.
